about.text: A milk-protein powder made from acid casein. Skimmed milk is acidified so its casein precipitates; the curd is washed, neutralised with sodium hydroxide or another sodium alkali, and dried. At least 90% protein, it is used in coffee whiteners, whipped toppings, nutritional products and bakery goods.

links.name: American Dairy Products Institute, Edible Caseinates standard

how.text: The standard caseinate. Sodium makes it freely soluble and a strong emulsifier (coffee whiteners, whipped toppings, meat products).
